GE Aerospace to buy Consolidated Precision Products $12 billion Howmet shares fall

findings.claim: Howmet 10-K 披露：多家最大客戶擁有自有高溫合金爐，自製翼型熔模鑄件供自用；其他公司亦生產並可能與 Howmet 競爭。
findings.excerpt: Several of Howmet’s largest customers have captive superalloy furnaces for producing airfoil investment castings for their own use.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因素：客戶整併可能使合併後實體以 Howmet 競爭對手取代 Howmet，減少需求。
findings.excerpt: Consolidation within Howmet’s customer base may result in customers who are better able to exert leverage in negotiating prices and other terms of sale, or may lead to reduced demand for Howmet’s products if a combined entity replaces Howmet with a Howmet competitor with which it had prior relationships.

findings.claim: GE Aerospace 同意以約 117.5 億美元收購鑄件供應商 CPP（Howmet 競爭對手），Howmet 股價下跌；市場解讀為 GE 增加自製關鍵件控制。
findings.source: Stockopedia/Reuters: Howmet falls after GE Aerospace agrees to buy CPP for nearly $12 billion

customer_second_source.note: 搜尋未見 RTX/Pratt 明確導入第二供應商或自製的來源。 線索 1 條，程式核實 0 條，1 條以搜尋摘要保留（未核原文）
